test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 2 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is: **Rivelry.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling should be **'Rivalry'.**
 
• **Rivalry** means competition for the same objective or for superiority in the same field.
 
 
• **Example-** *There always has been intense **rivalry** between the football clubs.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3** which is incorrectly spelt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Summary** means a brief statement or account of the main points of something.
 
• **Emigrate** means to leave one's own country in order to settle permanently in another.
 
• **Grandeur** means splendour and impressiveness, especially in appearance or style.
